correctness.rationale: The proof exhausts all composite factorization shapes with \(\Omega(n)\le3\). For \(p^2q\), the exact divisibility reduces to \(p(k+1)-2\mid k+2\) after \(q+1=kp\), leaving only \(12\). For squarefree triples, \(n-\varphi(n)>2(p+q+r)\), while divisibility would force \(n-\varphi(n)\mid2(p+q+r)\). Direct exact evaluation establishes the sharpness witness \(56\).
